cards.description_en: Fires peas in a straight line at zombies.
Burns every zombie in its row.
Wakes a sleeping mushroom so it can act during the day.
Produces sun periodically to fund more plants.
Blocks zombies with a durable defensive shell.
Fires peas that damage and slow the zombie they hit.
Swallows one nearby zombie, then pauses while digesting.
Fires two peas in succession down its lane.
Lobs melons that deal splash damage to nearby zombies.
A high, durable barrier that stops vaulting zombies.
